messages:
Maya: Starting design review for the error heatmap panel + drilldown. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/error-heatmap-v2 (see 'Legend / Drilldown' frame).
Jonah: First glance: legend labels are too light on light theme. Accessibility concern for AA contrast.
Sam: Also the gradient stops (low/med/high) are misleading for skewed distributions. Suggest showing numeric anchors: min / p50 / max under the legend.
Alex: I mocked a subtitle: title = 'Error density' + subtitle = 'Avg errors per minute (time buckets)'. Keeps the main label short but clarifies units. Thoughts?
Priya: Subtitle is good. Avoid parentheses in the main title if possible. Keep subtitle plain text.
Maya: Agree. We'll use 'Error density' with a muted subtitle.
Jonah: Drilldown table: correlation IDs are full UUIDs and break layout. Option A: truncate (first 8 + ellipsis) with tooltip for full value. Option B: shortened opaque id like 'corr_8a3f9c'. Which do we pick?
Sam: Truncate + tooltip + copy-to-clipboard. Make the ID cell keyboard-focusable (tabindex) and role=button so keyboard users can press Enter to copy.
Priya: For copy button aria-label keep it concise: a11y-bot recommended 'Copy correlation ID'. We should also include a visually hidden suffix like 'for selected request' dynamically.
a11y-bot: Auto-check: aria-label <= 80 chars. Recommend `Copy correlation ID` and include context via aria-describedby (visually hidden). Confirm focus order: tab to row, then action.
Alex: Export actions in the heatmap header overlap on narrow widths. Propose: primary visible 'Export traces' (CSV) button + overflow kebab for JSON/advanced options. Show keyboard shortcut in tooltip for primary.
Maya: Keep primary non-destructive style and explicit copy text on hover only: show '(CSV)'. Also include small explainer in modal about sampling.
Jonah: CSV columns proposed: correlation_id, trace_id, service, timestamp, error_message, sample_payload. Also include a column 'sampled' boolean if sampling applied.
Sam: Modal microcopy: 'Included rows: top matching traces by error count. Sampling applies when >5,000 results.' Short, scannable. Add link to docs for sampling policy.
Priya: Accessibility for modal: trap focus, restore focus on close, export confirm button uses aria-disabled when not ready. If download opens a new tab, ensure rel="noopener".
Alex: Keyboard shortcuts: Enter on focused correlation ID copies it, Shift+Enter opens trace details in new tab. Add both to global shortcuts list and show in tooltip.
Jonah: Tooltip copy for the legend: proposed two lines:
```
Counts are per-minute averages. Hover a cell to see exact counts and top affected services.
Click a cell to open the request drilldown.
```
Sam: Keep it simple for localization (no contractions). Also avoid punctuation-heavy strings in tooltips.
Priya: Contrast issue: the orange gradient stop fails AA with white text. Either darken the swatch or switch label color to black on that swatch.
Maya: I'll darken orange by ~7% in Figma and re-run contrast.
Alex: Mobile: heatmap collapses to list. Request: keep legend sticky at top while scrolling list so users keep context. Note: test paint/perf.
Maya: Added ticket note: 'mobile sticky legend - confirm paint cost acceptable'.
Jonah: Terminology inconsistency: we use 'Correlation ID', 'Trace ID', 'Span ID' across UI. Product decision: Correlation ID = request-level, Trace ID = backend distributed trace, Span ID = single operation. Suggest adding a glossary help icon in panel header.
Alex: I'll draft glossary copy and post. Suggested short entries for tooltip.
Maya: Small copy tweaks: change 'Trace correlation ID' to 'Correlation ID' in tables; change export hover to 'Export traces (CSV)'; change legend title to 'Error density'.
Sam: Edge case: keyboard-only users should be able to copy the ID without focusing the tiny copy icon. Make the whole ID cell respond to Enter. Add aria-live notification: 'Correlation ID copied to clipboard.'
Priya: And include visible feedback (toaster) that is dismissible and accessible. Ensure it announces via role="status" for SRs.
Maya: Thanks! I'll update the Figma file and push a new prototype link. Will call for another quick pass after the updates. :sparkles: 
Alex: :thumbsup:
Sam: :raised_hands:
Priya: :heart:
